Coiled asleep atop the gold, massive head resting on crossed foreclaws, wings folded like a tent over the treasure, smoke trickling slowly from its nostrils.
Roused and rearing, neck arched and jaws parting in a roar, wings flaring half-open, coins cascading off its scales as it lifts from the pile.
Head lowered and glaring straight at the viewer, one claw splayed possessively over the treasure, wings mantled, eyes burning — a clear warning.
One eye cracked open in a lazy sliver, body still coiled and motionless, a single claw twitching slightly against the gold, watching everything.
Draped boneless across the hoard like a cat in sun, chin propped on a gem-studded chalice, wings hanging loose and trailing off the pile.
Protectively curled tight around the treasure, neck snaked inward, wings wrapped close like a shell, every scale bristling, daring anything to come closer.
Lifting its great head slowly from slumber, neck rising in a long curve, wings stirring and half-spreading, eyes still drowsy but focusing fast.
Lounging regally upright on the hoard like a king on a throne, forelimbs resting on armrests of compacted gold, wings folded back with casual arrogance.
Sifting coins deliberately through its claws, head tilted down to watch them fall, wings relaxed and draped, deeply absorbed in counting its own wealth.
Just landed and settling, hind legs planted deep in the pile, wings still extended and beating to slow descent, neck low, coins exploding outward.
Sprawled on its back across the hoard, legs up, wings flopped wide open to either side, tail draped over a chest, utterly unconcerned.
Coiled tight but neck raised high and alert, head swiveling slowly toward a sound, wings pressed flat, body tense and ready to explode upward.
Pressing its cheek lovingly against a mountain of gold, eyes closed in bliss, forelimbs embracing the pile, wings folded, tail curled contentedly around behind.
Crouched low and predatory over the hoard, head thrust forward on a flat neck, wings half-lifted in threat, eyes fixed, absolutely still and lethal.
Seated upright with its tail coiled around the base of the hoard, chest puffed, wings fanned wide in full display, roaring at the chamber ceiling.
Stretched long and flat like a crocodile, chin resting on the gold, one forepaw forward, wings pinned back, a single eye tracking something at the door.
Rolling slowly in the gold like a dog in grass, legs in the air, wings beating awkwardly, coins and jewels scattering in every direction.
Hunched over a single gem with intense focus, wings folded neatly, head close to inspect it, forelimbs cupping the stone, everything else ignored entirely.
Sleeping deeply on its side, one wing spread beneath it like a mattress, neck curled back, jaws slightly parted, tail twitching faintly in a dream.
Standing four-square on the crest of the hoard, neck extended forward, wings fanned and rigid, silhouetted by firelight — a monument to possession.
Frozen mid-scratch, hind leg raised, neck twisted back to reach a spot on its flank, wings askew, completely undignified, oblivious to any intruder.
Coiling slowly tighter in sleep, drawing scattered coins inward with its tail, wings never opening, head sinking lower, settling deeper into unconsciousness.
Head hanging off the edge of the pile upside-down, surveying the chamber lazily from below, wings loosely spread, forelimbs dangling, deeply unbothered.
Pressed flat to the hoard with wings fully mantled overhead like a massive hood, invisible from above, one eye open, perfectly still and ambushing.
Drowsily propped on one forelimb, head lolling and heavy, wings half-furled unevenly, tail coiled loose, fighting sleep it is clearly losing against the gold's warmth.
